title: Sapporo Drug Store says contractor CyberAgent left data on 22万9026 customer accounts publicly accessible
date_note: ITmedia's article of 26 November says the company announced it on 25 November.
geo_basis: headquarters of the company; the source does not state a victim city
summary: Sapporo Drug Store announced on 25 November that data on 22万9026 customer accounts was exposed by its app contractor CyberAgent, which placed a file in a publicly set storage area during a system migration. ITmedia reports the file was public from 16 July 2025 to 18 November 2026 and a third party retrieved it nine times between 3 January and 31 October 2026. The company says it was not an external cyberattack.
plain: Sapporo Drug Store says a contractor's mistake left data on 22万9026 customer accounts publicly accessible for more than a year. According to ITmedia, third parties retrieved it nine times between 3 January and 31 October 2026.
exec: A contractor's migration error exposed data on 22万9026 customer accounts of a retail chain, which says it was not an external cyberattack.

evidence.quote: 22万9026アカウント分が流出したと発表した
26年1月3日から10月31日までの間に、第三者により計9回取得されていたことを確認した。

validation.note: One publisher (ITmedia NEWS) relaying the company's announcement; the company's own notice was not found or read.

review.note: figure: retrieval count nine times now scoped to 3 Jan-31 Oct 2026 as ITmedia states, plural third parties, evidence quote added
